title: Front Row Expands to Seoul to Support Korean Brands in U.S. Growth - KuCoin

Front Row Expands to Seoul to Support Korean Brands in U.S. Growth | KuCoin Home News Details Front Row Expands to Seoul to Support Korean Brands in U.S. Growth 
 币界网 Release Time: 2026/10/29 14:13:54 Share COMMON $0.0₄5162 -1.41% Summary Front Row, a growth partner for brands on Amazon, TikTok Shop, and Shopify, has opened a new office in Seoul to support Korean beauty, health, and pharmaceutical brands in their expansion into the U.S. The Seoul office is the company’s sixth, following locations in New York, San Diego, Hamburg, Bratislava, and Amsterdam. Korean beauty sales on Amazon surged 80% in H1 2026, significantly outpacing the category average of 27%. Jinny Kim, with 25 years of experience from Coupang, Ogilvy, and GroupM, leads the new office. Front Row aims to help Korean brands scale profitably, maintain brand control, and deliver the level of support required for success in the U.S. market. Some altcoins may react to such cross-border growth trends. CoinDesk reports: The newly established Seoul office will serve rapidly growing Korean beauty, health and wellness, and pharmaceutical brands.
 New York, October 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — Front Row, a global growth partner that helps brands lead on Amazon, TikTok Shop, and Shopify, today announced its expansion into South Korea, providing direct local support to Korean beauty, health and wellness, and pharmaceutical brands to launch and scale their businesses in the U.S. market.
 Seoul has become Front Row’s sixth global office, joining locations in New York, San Diego, Hamburg, Bratislava, and Amsterdam. This expansion comes as Korean brands experience rapid growth in the U.S., with Amazon becoming one of the most important channels for reaching American consumers. In the first half of 2026, sales of Korean skincare products on Amazon reached $818 million, an 80% increase compared to $456 million in the same period of 2025; in contrast, the overall skincare category on the platform grew by only 27% during the same period, meaning Korean-related products grew at roughly three times the rate.
 The Seoul office will be led by Jinny Kim, Senior Vice President in Korea. With 25 years of professional experience at companies such as Coupang, Dentsu, Ogilvy, Mintel, and GroupM, she has served Korean and global brands across local and international institutions, bringing extensive expertise in driving the growth of Korean brands on the global business stage.
 Jinny Kim, Senior Vice President of Front Row Korea, said: “Korean brands operate at a speed and with a cultural intuition that is difficult to replicate elsewhere: trend cycles are shorter, content and commerce are inseparable, and founders need partners who understand this rhythm. Through my experiences at GroupM, Ogilvy, Dentsu, Mintel, and most recently at Coupang, I’ve continuously understood this from both perspectives. This is precisely the value I aim to bring to this role: connecting my deep understanding of how Korean brands operate with Front Row’s global infrastructure and commercial execution capabilities established in the U.S. and Europe. My job is to ensure that brands in K-Beauty, health and wellness, and pharmaceuticals can maintain their own pace while accelerating their global scaling.”
 Front Row said that in Seoul, the company will help Korean brands address the most common challenges hindering their growth in the United States:
 Achieve profitable growth in the U.S.: Accelerate growth on platforms like Amazon and TikTok Shop to help brands move from initial launch to category leadership.
 Regain control from resellers: Take charge of product pages, pricing, and digital storefronts so that your brand, not unauthorized sellers, defines how American consumers perceive it.
 Create content tailored to U.S. consumers: Build brand identity and develop content that aligns product narratives, key selling points, and visual elements with local buyer preferences.
 Increase brand discoverability: Generate demand through retail media, SEO, and optimization for AI search, while driving innovation in digital flagship stores on platforms like Shopify.
 Make decisions based on real-time data: Integrate live dashboards and AI-generated insights from Front Row’s proprietary business intelligence platform, Catapult, with the strategy team’s actionable execution, enabling the brand to monitor performance and respond promptly.
 Christopher Skinner, Co-Founder and Chief Revenue Officer of Front Row, said: “Korea is shaping far more than the next wave of ‘K-Beauty.’ It is influencing how the global beauty industry understands innovation, products, content, and commerce. Expanding Front Row into Korea gives us the opportunity to directly connect this ecosystem with the expertise we’ve built in driving growth for beauty, health, wellness, and pharmaceutical brands in the U.S. and Europe. With Jinny—our first senior local hire—joining us, we are building a two-way bridge: helping Korean brands translate their local strengths into sustainable global growth, while bringing our international partners closer to innovation and insights from Korea.”
 Front Row will hold a special event in Seoul in early 2027 to celebrate its launch; further details will be announced later.
 About Front Row 
 Front Row is a global growth partner that helps brands lead and win across e-commerce platforms. The company integrates brand building, content creation, demand generation, platform acceleration, and digital flagship innovation into a unified system, powered by its proprietary business intelligence platform, Catapult. The Front Row team consists of over 550 professionals from 40 countries and regions, with six offices in New York, San Diego, Hamburg, Bratislava, Amsterdam, and Seoul. Its clients include Glossier, Tatcha, Ouai, Sol de Janeiro, K18, and La Mer. For more information, visit frontrowgroup.com.
